title: Polymarket Offers $50 Bonus on Sports Bets
seoTitle: Polymarket Offers $50 Bonus on Sports Bets
subtitle: Codes SBWIRE, CUSE, and SILIVE Provide $60 in Purchasing Power with a $10 Deposit
excerpt: Traders can earn a $50 bonus using Polymarket codes for NFL and MLB bets, with deposits as low as $10 and immediate market access.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
With the NFL week kicking off and the Yankees-Rockies game underway, three Polymarket promo codes have gained prominence by offering a $50 bonus for those who deposit $10. The offer has attracted thousands of new users looking to operate in sports prediction markets.

How the SBWIRE Code Works for the NFL

By entering the SBWIRE code during registration, users receive a $50 bonus as soon as their $10 deposit is confirmed. The bonus allows trading in NFL markets, including the Patriots vs. Seahawks season opener.

CUSE Promotion for Yankees vs. Rockies

In the states of California, Colorado, and New York, the CUSE code guarantees a $50 bonus upon depositing $10, totaling $60 in purchasing power. The betting market shows the Yankees as favorites with a price of 75¢, indicating a 75% probability of victory.

SILIVE and the Mets vs. Marlins Game

The SILIVE code, active since September 8, 2026, offers the same $50 bonus for new users who deposit $10. The funds can be used in all open markets, including MLB, politics, crypto, and global events.

Features of the Polymarket Prediction Market

Polymarket operates as a peer-to-peer market, where contract prices reflect the implicit probability of each event. A contract trading at 60¢ indicates a 60% chance of occurrence. Positions can be sold before settlement, allowing for profit or loss limitation.

Regulation and Availability in the US

Trading in the United States is conducted through QCEX, an exchange registered with the CFTC, and contracts are settled on the Polygon blockchain using USDC. The platform is available in 48 states and the District of Columbia, excluding Nevada and Minnesota.

With information from Golfweek, Syracuse.com, SILive.com.
